Looking to simplify retail AP? This guide breaks down how automation can save money, reduce back-office chaos, and help you focus more on your customers


## Why Retail Teams Choose Ottimate:


****Cut Accounts Payable Costs by 80%**** . Automate manual AP tasks like invoice processing and approvals, saving your team time and drastically reducing overhead.


****Gain Real-Time Spend Visibility**** . Monitor purchases, manage budgets, and make informed decisions with live dashboards and advanced reporting.


****Eliminate Manual Errors and Lost Invoices**** . With AI-powered invoice capture and 3-way matching, Ottimate ensures accuracy and compliance with every transaction.


****Integrate Seamlessly with Your Systems**** . Ottimate connects effortlessly to popular accounting and inventory platforms like QuickBooks, Sage, and more.
